title: Transitive symmetry of the OR function
statement: For every natural number $n$, the OR function on sign vectors of length $n$, which returns $1$ exactly when every coordinate is $1$ and returns $-1$ otherwise, is invariant under coordinate permutations, and for any two coordinates there is such a permutation sending the first coordinate to the second.
